title: I made an open source version of Polyfork.
author: dancingwithlies
selftext:
Meet Polyspoon.                                                              

I saw Polyfork charging for AI low poly models made by code.. HOW CAN SOMEONE EVEN THINK OF THAT ?

No.. no way..

This can be open source, we as a community can make a better engine for those models and improve it.. anyone can submit a new model or PR to improve the generation code..

They got 500k in cash from a hackathon.. for this.. I couldnt take it.. so i made my own, we can vote models, humans reviews, you can become a reviewer/moderator, you can have a ranking of who has the most voted/best models etc.. 

Lets make a big ass model market that is free for everyone.. to enter, to participate, to grow and improve.

Its very early now, so all models i made are quite bad, and some stuff might break, thats the reality.. but its here and I will keep working on it..

So pls try it out, make some models, its free.

I will be reviewing people models by hand to stop racism or porn stuff, but who knows maybe in the future i can add a NSFW store etc..

check it out at [https://polyspoon.com/](https://polyspoon.com/) and check the [github](https://github.com/DITlieD/polyspoon) and star it pls, would help me out.

comments.author: Tedreak
comments.body: Thank you for this. Is it Nvidia only? Or does it run just as well on AMD?

replies.author: dancingwithlies
replies.body: Runs on anything bro, we can improve the engine to make better models with time, as a community

comments.author: dancingwithlies
comments.body: I am already fixing some bugs that appeared on the release, like the models i made have no preview image and a weird name, but anything you guys find create a issue/PR on github

replies.author: iolmao
replies.body:
Hey, interestin project! How did you get extra deals in AI usage?

I'm not a fan of pre-made assets outside game MVPs and prototypes - is the library flexible to be used with AI as a starting point and modify it with the mood of the game?

replies.author: dancingwithlies
replies.body:
Yeah, Polyfork engine is closed, i tried to come closer to its engine, still a little off but with itineration you can get pretty good models on different styles, so yes.

I got extra AI usage by taking part of the open source programs of AI coding and other more "grey area" ways.. like using grey market routers that sell usage for cheap, but you need to run those inside a sandbox so theres no risk

Yeah i just need you guys help, to improve the engine and make more models, share, create a community etc.

its fairly broken rn but i am fixing the most i can, i got some nice deals in AI usage so i will be improving it a lot.
